image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, light-colored surface (likely stone or concrete) with scattered dry leaves. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and patches. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. Forelimbs and hindlimbs are visible, showing short, stout digits. The tail extends towards the top left, partially out of focus. There is some gibberish text/watermark in the bottom right corner.
